content.text: Elon Musk Confirms TSMC-Terafab Talks: In an Oct. 3 post, Culpan linked his earlier report, published Oct. 2, that TSMC was exploring ways to work with Terafab. The post says Musk characterized the contact as discussions and reproduces Culpan's claim that Intel collaboration was not progressing. These are evidence of reported talks and a counterclaim, not a signed TSMC arrangement or confirmed Intel withdrawal; the Intel-progress claim is not an Intel statement. (time=2026-10-03; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).

content.text:
Intel to Keep Working on Elon Musk’s Terafab Chipmaking Venture: The Bloomberg-syndicated article reports that CEO Lip-Bu Tan told Bloomberg Intel would continue working with Musk on Terafab, before a Tokyo event marking Intel's 50th year in Japan. It does not disclose a contract, production scope, capacity, quantities, or schedule. The available copy shows no update marker. (time=2026-10-07T04:32:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Intel to keep working on Musk's Terafab chipmaking venture, Bloomberg News reports: Reuters repeats the statement with attribution to Bloomberg and says Intel and Tesla had not immediately responded to requests for comment outside regular business hours. This is contemporaneous secondary coverage, not separate confirmation of Tan's remarks. (time=2026-10-07T05:12:00Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
